hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: WPA2 association profile and selected AP
inputs.revision: WPA2 test against the same configured AP as the prior association trial; identifiers omitted.

scenario: On one operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample, run WPA2-PSK/CCMP/PMF0 against the configured AP using RAM-loaded kernel #15 and the one-shot RX-chain/runtime-table diagnostic.
expected: The bounded diagnostic records ROM RX callback entry counts and live function-table bindings across association, then reports the station/AP outcome.
observed: The station reached ASSOCIATED with power save WIFI_PS_NONE (enum 0), but did not complete WPA and disconnected locally with reason 204 after the vendor's PTK four-way handshake timeout. The 12.3593-second diagnostic window reported zero entries at sta_input, crypto_decap, decap and sta_rx_eapol. The live table pointer remained 0x2f0306a0, table_changed=0, wrapper_match=1, and begin/end slot masks were 0xf/0xf. Router records at 23:16:07 reported association and at 23:16:17 deauthentication by the station after the PTK handshake timeout; clock mapping to kernel uptime is unavailable. These records do not establish whether M1 was transmitted or acknowledged over the air. No EAPOL input or WPA_COMPLETED was observed.

measurements.name: runtime-rx-table-wrapper-slots
measurements.unit: slots matched; mask 0xf at begin and end

limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and one RAM-loaded diagnostic-kernel run; this does not establish another board revision or persistent Wi-Fi support.

The live table snapshot confirms all four instrumented ROM callback slots matched the wrappers during this window. Zero entries place the observed boundary before sta_input but do not establish that an EAPOL frame was transmitted over the air or received by the radio.

This trial did not sample hardware RX counters or internal-pool miss/fallback counters. A later bounded measurement can compare opaque hardware-counter activity with allocation pressure, but Espressif does not document the counter increment conditions or frame types; the counters cannot establish DATA or EAPOL reception, or by themselves distinguish radio filtering from memory pressure.
Router records confirm association and the subsequent PTK handshake timeout, not AP EAPOL transmission or station ACK. Clock mapping between router and kernel observations is unavailable.
No EAPOL input, WPA_COMPLETED, negotiated PMF, IP address, DNS or accepted network data exchange was observed. Wi-Fi support remains partial.
